The second photo shows no tray, just an "Oops!" card, so I can't see what was left over. I'll assume the person ate the whole meal and estimate the full meal from the first photo.

Estimated items:
- Sushi: 3 pieces of maki, about 90 g and 130 kcal.
- Two rice paper rolls (fresh rolls), about 70 g each, so about 140 g and 200 kcal.
- Fruit salad bowl (watermelon, grapes, orange, berries), about 200 g and 100 kcal.
- Juice glass, about 200 g and 90 kcal.

Totals: 130 + 200 + 100 + 90 = 520 kcal, and 90 + 140 + 200 + 200 = 630 g.
